A 2019 Zulip package-spec thread records the historical transition from fhir-version-list to fhirVersions, supporting the current legacy-note wording. The Jira resolution text has a pluralized spelling, but the issue description and historical thread use fhir-version-list.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the active package documentation already implements the Jira decision and the combined branch contains that source sentence.
